Question: What was the best relationship advice you ever got?
Answer: So……………… I had a really good friend in school. Let's call her maya. She had her first relationship when she was in 6th standard. The guy was a teacher's son and was in 10th standard. Many people were against this relationship because let's be honest 6th class girl and 10th class boy is kind of a taboo…… The guy ended the relationship in a month. Saying that he only dated her because he got a dare from his friends………………. I mean what the hell!!!!!!!! Maya was a mess after this……………… Then, next year a new guy came to school. Who proposed her and she accepted. So she started her 2nd relationship in 7th standard, wishing that it will heal her from her first relationship. And it did, it really did. She was again become her normal self. Happy and sweet. But then it get worse……….. The guy changes the school and few weeks after that maya gets to know that the guy was cheating on her……. Not just one but with two girls. The worst part was both of those girls knew he was committed in a relationship and they had no problem with it. One of those girls was actually Maya's friend……….. Maya was really broken at this point but she always carried a brave face in the school. Like it didn't affected her. But it did. She cried several times in washroom and I was with her. I was witnessing everything but was not able to do anything….. After that, she dated multiple boys. She never truly liked them. I don't even know why she did it. I could see that she has changed as a person. She is not the same person anymore whom I called my friend. I started distancing myself from her because………. I will be honest. My studies were getting affected and at this point she had a really bad image in school because of dating so many guys. It went on in 8th and 9th class…………….. In 10th class, she somewhat took a step back…….. we started talking again and I got to know that she was taking depression medicine. I felt guilty because I left her when she probably needed me the most. At the end of 10th class, she started liking a guy. It was the first time that she was taking true intrest in some guy and it was not a fling or anything. She truly truly started loving that person. He was in our class only. Then they got into relationship. Maya started getting better as the relationship continued. Even I felt that he was the right person for her. Buttttttt…………… One day he Ghosted her. He stoped talking to her even though we were in same class. He blocked her from everywhere. She begged him to atleast tell her why he was doing this all of a sudden. But he just ignored her. That was something that truly broke her. Everyday she would come to school and cry when ever she saw him. She no longer cared who was watching her…….. None of the other guys broke her like this one did…. It was horrible….. I changed school after this, I have no clue how she is doing anymore…. So, coming to the point…… the best relationship advice I ever got was…… Never let anyone in your life, be your life. Know how and when to detach. The most important relationship you have is with yourself. Don't ruin it. Maya gave this advice to me……….. If I ever meet her again, I will tell her how strong she is, one guy used her, next one cheated on her and the worst one Ghosted her but she loved them all with her all. Most of you might call her nibbi ( many called her), but I can tell you for sure that she wasn't. In 6th class too she was way mature than that 10th standard guy. How o know this? Because she doesn't hate anyone of them even after what they did to her. She truly wanted them all to be happy where they were…………… if this is nibbi's love, then it's the purest form of love. The love radha did to kanha, sati did to shiv, sita did to ram. ( I am not comparing, just giving context.) When you hurt someone and they still wish you nothing but the best, know that you have lost one of the good once. Evara 🌻

Question: Why don't people understand good advice and they understand it later?
Answer: Scene — me and my best friend in chemistry lab, trying to find out the viscosity of alcohol. My bff — I think that guy is staring at me. Question: What is something you don’t realize until you get older?
Answer: Actually, answer is in the question only — That we start realising as we get older, there is no realising factory involved in childhood. Our childhood brain is so much unaware of all the risks around us that it just makes life easier. Whereas as we grow older “what if" becomes our favourite question. I remember that in childhood I didn't really think much before I ran out of my school in interval without any permission when I was in ukg ……….. (and then I got lost, my parents and teachers got so worried but I was just chilling on sand dunes. it was better than attending maths class. I also figured out a fun fact that I don't have camel feets, so it's hard to walk on hot sand in July heat.) But would I do such stupidity…….. sorry, experiment now……………….. no. Obviously. Not because I don't want to but because I can predict the outcome. Which includes a lot of scolding and 'if you do that ever again’ threats from my parents and teachers. As we grow old, we get aware of all the risk around us. Isn't it? We can predict all the worst outcome that somehow always overtake all the good outcome. It's always — What if I didn't get a placement? What if I didn't make it? What if my friends laugh at me when I give English speech in assembly? What if my parents didn't like me if they knew the real me? What if I failed? And so on……… I feel like courage is not getting over your fear of risk. It's actually being unaware of the risk. Honestly, there are so many things I would be doing right now instead of writing this answer, only if I was unaware of the risks and predictable outcomes. I would be so carefree and so adventures and so experimental………. That I wouldn't have time to think about 'maybe I should have said this instead of that on that day when I was in argument with so and so person’………… what a waste of time!!!!!!!! Believe it or not childhood is savage. it's our real “I don't give a shit" phase. I can bet you on this that you were more courageous and brave in your childhood than you are now…… Got the inspiration for writing this answer through this meme . Evara 🌻

Question: What was your bullying experience?
Answer: Okayyyyyyyyyy, I have never shared this with anybody before. It wasn't a harsh physical bullying or anything……… it was more like emotionally tormenting. So, till 4th standard, I used to study in a school that was near my house. It was a pretty decent school but wasn't that good. So my father decided to change my school in 5th standard. He send me to the best and most expensive school of my district. I consider it one of my privileges for being able to attend that school. because it was just really good. The first week of school went really good. Although I was struggling academically a bit because my english was poor at that time and all my classmates seemed to have really good English speaking skills. But I made friends there the very first day. Let's call them x, y and z. Things were going great. But…….. I don't know what happened z started teasing me with a guy's name. I didn't took it seriously because friends do this. We all have done it too right. It went on for like months and then I really started to get irritated because this joke was now turning into a rumour. And rumour spread like wild fire in my school. So I told x, y and z to stop it already. But they didn't. And I was like what 9 — 10 years old then and they were too. Then one fine day, just a day before our summer holidays. They were teasing me as always. It was time to leave the school and we were walking in queue toward our bus and there they were shouting that guys name behind me. I don't know what came over me, I just turned around and slapped z on the face. Her specs fell to the ground and maybe it broke too, i don't really know because I just left then. Maybe it was my mistake. They were my friends after all…… Summer Holidays went like all summer holidays go. And it was time to go back to school. But nothing was same as before…………… I was doing well at academics now also part taking in extracurricular activities. But no girl of my class would talk to me. They would not sit with me, eat with me, play with me and also wouldn't help me in any ways. Except one girl, let's call he p. P had some sort of face disfigurement due to some allergy. I don't exactly know what. She was already an — 'don't talk to her’ — kid of our class and now I was too. So it was idol of us to become friends. Boys of my class were good to me. They knew what was going on but they didn't wanted to be a part of cat fight. So they stayed aside but helped me if they could. Few of the incident that happened at that time were — Small small things like this kept happening throughout the year. I and p got used to this and we became comfortable in our own space. She became my best friend. ( She loved to tickle me and I hated it.) Now the fun part and also the hardest — It was December time, means annual function time. And I loved loved loved dancing. I was so determined to take part in dance but when I got to know that x y z are dancing too. I dumped the idea. There used to be just one dance from every class so………… you got the point right. So I went to art and craft department with p. But after one day only p understand that art and craft is not my thing. So she told me to go for dance. She said “tu kab tak yaar un logo se darti rahegi just go and give audition at least.” And so I went after losing argument from p. The next day when I went there, the teacher said that team has already been decided. So try next year. And I begged her to just see me dancing once and then she could decide. After so many efforts, she finally said okay. And then I danced. Now I am not flaunting myself here but I dance good. Got this from my mother. Teacher then decided to take me in the team. But here's the thing. There could only be 7 members. That means I was going to replace one. You know who I replaced? - Z 😂. I wouldn't lie, I felt like laughing so bad but I controlled some how. Not only that, ma'am also gave me center position which was initially X's. And omg! The murderous look she had on her face……….. I knew she was going go give me a hard time. And that's what happened. On the last day of are dance practice, when I went back in class to wear my shoes…………. My shoes were not there. Everyone were wearing their shoes and packing their bags, buses were ready to leave and my shoes were nowhere to be seen. I went from class to class to find them. Even went to girls washroom to check. But they were nowhere to be found. All the buses left…….. and I was the only student left in school. I went to staff room and told teachers about it. Firstly, all the teachers scolded me that why I didn't tell them before the buses left and How was I supposed to go home now. Secondly, everyone who was left in school were searching for my shoes now. It seems so funny now when I recall the situation. All sweeper uncle and aunts, the Gardener, all the teachers and management staff were searching my shoes 😅. Literally everyone except the principal. From that day onwards, everyone knew me in my school by my name. Even the sweepers and gardener uncle. I went from no-one to extremely known in a day. ( Vo alag bat hai ki fir sab mujhe shoe wali ladki bulake chidate the 😂 gardener uncle was so savage, everytime he would see me, he would be like — beta jute sambhalke kahi nikal na jaye.) Well my one shoe was found in boys washroom and one is still lost somewhere in school premises. And one of my sir dropped me to home that day. After that day, I never got bullied. X y z, had actually started talking to me nicely. I still wonder what changed…………………. But now when I think about all these, I only smile and laugh…………… Happy endings….. Evara 🌻
